meta.name: Mystic Pop up Bar 720p
meta.description:
At this mysterious late-night food cart run by an equally mysterious woman and her part-timer, customers are provided a space for respite and counseling through their dreams. But most importantly, everyone here is treated equally—living or dead.

Complete series. On your server: S1 12/12

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Weol-ju is intrigued when a tight-lipped customer who refuses to open up about her problems suddenly starts pouring out her heart to Han Kang-bae.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Kang-bae isn't sure he wants to work for Weol-ju. But he does want to help his neighbor, a woman who is plagued by guilt from her past.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Weol-ju attacks a rotten system that's thrown her latest customer into despair. Kang-bae makes contact with an unusual woman.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: At an event held in the afterlife, Kang-bae meets a man who's determined to win the prize: lottery ticket numbers for his living descendant.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Weol-ju and Guibanjang chase after a wayward spirit who has a problem moving on. Kang-bae asks Kang Yeo-rin to be his partner for a dance contest.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Kang-bae and Yeo-rin start taking dance lessons. When their instructor reveals a heartbreaking personal struggle, Weol-ju has an idea for a solution.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Tasked by Yeomradaewang with fixing an afterlife slip-up, Weol-ju, Guibanjang and Kang-bae devise a plan that hinges on victory at the dance contest.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: A haunted apartment turns out to be occupied by a dead web novelist with a sad real-life love story. Kang-bae mopes over romantic woes of his own.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: While seeking a way to keep her end of the deal with Kang-bae, Weol-ju comes up against a hellish decision. Yeombujang stirs up trouble.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: The appearance of a face from the past dredges up cruel memories for Guibanjang and Weol-ju. Kang-bae saves Yeo-rin from a hurtful situation.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Yeo-rin is mystified when a strange voice begins to prevent her from touching Kang-bae. Weol-ju confronts new truths about Guibanjang.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Following a huge revelation, Weol-ju and Guibanjang take on a final case to resolve, and do everything they can to protect Kang-bae.

meta.slogan: Come you poor anguished souls, Won't you have a drink with us?
